title: Story premise ENT065: The Treasure Beneath the Caption
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: The clue is being covered by the clue. Takeaway/theme: Explanations can obstruct the thing they explain.
description: A treasure hunter searches a minimalist stage for a tiny key, but every explanatory caption lands directly over it. The hunter grabs the floating SEARCH HERE text and moves it aside, revealing the key; the final label reads MAYBE LESS TEXT and stays safely in the corner.
